**Chinese name:** 上海兆芯集成电路股份有限公司 (Zhàoxīn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The state-backed (Shanghai United Investment 50.07%) second x86 path — the only domestic vendor natively running standard Windows+Linux binaries on desktops; a July 2026 central-government (央采) laptop procurement put Zhaoxin-based machines at ~50% of domestic portable PC awards (联想开天 N80z on KX-7000/ZX86). STAR IPO accepted June 2025 (¥41.69亿 planned raise); inquiry responses (May 2026 round two) showed FY2025 revenue ¥11.11亿 (+54.8%) against a ¥10.28亿 loss — and the review is currently paused: the SSE marked Zhaoxin's application '中止（财报更新）' on 30 September 2026 when the financials lapsed, a routine suspension expected to lift once H1 2026 audited numbers are re-filed; no listing-committee meeting (上会) has yet been held. Its KH-50000 server CPU (up to 96 cores) notched only ¥9.91 million of 2025 revenue in 500-chip volumes but is in validation at Lenovo Kaitian and China Mobile's DICT supplier library; the KX-8000 desktop chip (4GHz-class, iGPU, PCIe 5.0/DDR5) is promised but unlaunched as of October 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

x86-compatible desktop/server/embedded CPUs, chipsets, instruction-set extensions; GPU affiliate.
